\chapter{Prefix Sums \& Difference Arrays}
\label{ch:prefix_sums}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Precompute once, answer every range sum in $\bigO{1}$; record range updates at their two ends and recover the array with one pass.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{900}{1700}{6}{13}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Prefix sums: definition, the off-by-one-free convention $P[0]=0$, range sums as $P[r]-P[l]$
    \item Difference arrays: the inverse of prefix sums; range add in $\bigO{1}$, rebuild in $\bigO{n}$
    \item Two dimensions: inclusion--exclusion for rectangle sums and rectangle updates
    \item Prefix sums with a hash map: counting subarrays by their sum, remainder or balance
    \item Prefix and suffix of other operations: XOR, product, minimum, maximum (leaders), and when an operation has no inverse
    \item Split points: every way to cut an array into two or three parts, from prefix and suffix sums
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Range sum queries} --- Static Range Sum Queries {\small\color{darkgray}(CSES 1646)}, Find Pivot Index {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 724)}
    \item \textbf{Prefix sums with a hash map} --- Subarray Sum Equals K {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 560)}, Subarray Sums Divisible by K {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 974)}, Good Subarrays {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1398C)}
    \item \textbf{Difference arrays} --- Corporate Flight Bookings {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1109)}, Greg and Array {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 295A)}
    \item \textbf{Two-dimensional prefix sums} --- Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 304)}, Maximum Side Length of a Square with Sum Less than or Equal to Threshold {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1292)}
    \item \textbf{Prefix and suffix of other operations} --- Product of Array Except Self {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 238)}, XOR Queries of a Subarray {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1310)}
    \item \textbf{Split points: cutting the array into parts} --- Number of Ways to Split Array {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2270)}, Three Parts of the Array {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1006C)}
\end{enumerate}
\end{plannedbox}
